label: sound
reasons: Every hidden-test assertion corresponds directly to behavior the instruction states; no new names, formats, or extra contracts appear in the tests beyond the described fix.

Every hidden test scenario corresponds to an explicitly described behavior in the instruction; exact numeric expectations (e.g. speed==2.0, time_remaining==6) are directly computable from the stated rules, and fields like finished_speed, Task.speed, and Progress.reset pre-exist in rich.

All tested behaviors (speed from deltas, non-positive deltas ignored, ceil'd time_remaining, frozen finished_time/finished_speed, reset and total-change invalidation) are explicitly described in the instruction; names like speed, time_remaining, finished_speed and the reset/update signatures are pre-existing public API of rich's Task/Progress, so nothing unstated remains.
